<p>We see you, Vandy! A little smack talk thrown your way, and y’all go and win <em>two</em> SEC games in a row…first time in four years?! Glad Alabama already played you this season. You have improved every week, and we are rooting <em>hard </em>for you this weekend against the vols. </p><p>Speaking of things to be grateful for…it’s that time of season to count our blessings:</p><p>Family and friends, </p><p>Health, </p><p>Election season is over,</p><p>Coach Saban will coach another 10 or so years,</p><p>Alabama Men’s Basketball is looking good,</p><p>Alabama Soccer is killing it and </p><p>Wonderful football fans like you!</p><p>&nbsp;But...it is rivalry weekend…so, back by popular demand…it’s time to get your <em>hate-on</em> in between <em>bouts of gratitude</em>. You know how it’s done – you just need to fine tune your nice/nasty skills. Now don’t say, “Who…me!? I don’t know how to do that.” Yes, <em>you</em>! We’ve all got it in us. </p><p>&nbsp;For example, you might say to your auburn buddy at Thanksgiving dinner, “Glad you made it today. Thought y’all might still be at Jordan Hare Stadium celebrating that win over texas am to avoid last place in the sec west.”</p><p>&nbsp;To your favorite kentucky fan, you could lead with a compliment and then go low with, “Remember when you beat florida at the start of the season, and we thought y’all were more than a basketball school?…That was fun.” </p><p>&nbsp;To the dreaded georgia family member…throw some shade, “Like your haircut. You get it done same place Stetson Bennett goes?”</p><p>&nbsp;For the Commodores in your life (and only if you have<strong> no heart or soul at all</strong>) smash their moment with, “I remember that time Alabama could only celebrate back-to- back sec wins, and it was the worst year of my life…but good for you!”</p><p>&nbsp;To the ole miss cousin, “I care about you. I want to help. How can I contribute to the <em>Keep Lane Kiffin Fund</em> so y’all don’t have to hire your fourth new coach in the past ten years?”</p><p>&nbsp;The black sheep tennessee relative needs to hear from you. <em>Let ‘em have it!</em> “I am sooooo sorry Georgia crushed your spirit and South Cackalacky took away your will to live, but, seriously…<em>get over</em> yourself already. This time last year you were throwing mustard at Lane Kiffin for beating you in Neyland Stadium…looking at the glass half empty here. (Depending on the reaction you might add, “You exceeded all expectations this year. You are doing incredibly well for a bunch of hillbillies.”)</p><p>&nbsp;When you see that aggie side of the family, </p><p><span style="color: black;"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," height="128" width="320"></span></p><p>“Where did all your fans go at half time Saturday? Were they giving away Taylor Swift tickets at the concession stands?” </p><p>&nbsp;You totally got this! Just throw in some accolades <em>then</em> mix in the messages of doubt. You are <em>absolutely </em>smart enough to pull this off…<em>or are you</em>? Think of it as pulling off the best show of gratitude of all...that <em>you ain’t them</em>!</p><p>&nbsp;RTR and Happy Thanksgiving – <strong>grateful for</strong> <strong>ALL of YOU</strong>! Beat the Aubs and go Vandy! </p><p>&nbsp;Jackie </p><p>&nbsp;</p>
